title: Loop-OPF: Solver-Informed Learning for Optimal Power Flow with Inference-Time Topology Adaptivity
abstract: arXiv:2611.27013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning for optimal power flow (OPF) has recently been advocated to accelerate OPF solutions by using a pre-trained neural network (NN) to predict directly from given inputs such as the load demand. However, existing learning-for-OPF methods largely fall short of ensuring the optimality and feasibility of their predictions. They also struggle to adapt at inference time to unseen topology scenarios, such as those caused by line or generator outages. This work puts forth Loop-OPF, a solver-informed NN that builds its layers from the iterations of the primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method. Under standard convexity and regularity conditions on DC-OPF, the resultant fixed-point output of Loop-OPF is thus optimal and feasible. To speed up PDHG across diverse OPF scenarios, Loop-OPF learns certain PDHG parameters in a self-supervised manner, without any OPF solution labels. translated_title: Loop-OPF：面向最优潮流的求解器引导学习与推理时拓扑自适应性
translated_abstract: 近年来，基于学习的最优潮流（OPF）方法被提倡用于加速OPF求解，即通过预训练神经网络（NN）直接根据给定输入（如负荷需求）进行预测。然而，现有的OPF学习方法在很大程度上无法保证其预测的最优性与可行性，并且在推理时难以适应未见过的拓扑场景，例如由线路或发电机停运引起的场景。本工作提出了Loop-OPF，这是一种求解器引导的神经网络，其网络层由原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法的迭代构建而成。在DC-OPF的标准凸性与正则性条件下，Loop-OPF所得的不动点输出因此是最优且可行的。为了在各种OPF场景下加速PDHG求解，Loop-OPF以自监督的方式学习某些PDHG参数，而无需任何OPF解标签。我们采用深度平衡（DEQ）框架进行训练，从……
tldr: Loop-OPF是一种由PDHG迭代构建的求解器引导神经网络，在凸性条件下保证DC-OPF预测的最优性与可行性，并通过自监督方式学习PDHG参数实现无需解标签的加速训练与对推理时未见拓扑的自适应。
en_tdlr: Loop-OPF is a solver-informed neural network built from PDHG iterations that guarantees optimal and feasible DC-OPF predictions under convexity conditions, while learning PDHG parameters in a self-supervised, label-free manner to accelerate solving and adapt to unseen topologies at inference time.
